_doc: Single source of truth for Pass 1 name normalization. Keys are 'compact' (lowercase alnum). make: our DB slug -> canonical make key. govMake: compact NHTSA/EPA make name -> canonical key. nhtsaName: canonical -> exact NHTSA Make_Name to query. makeWindows: [minYear,maxYear] the make sold cars in the US (outside = impossible). model: '<make>:<ourKey>' or '<ourKey>' -> list of equivalent gov keys (applied symmetrically). modelPatterns: regexes turning a gov model key into a family key (e.g. c300 -> cclass).
_makeWindowsNote: makeWindows may hold 2 or 4 numbers (two ranges). datsun/delorean/amc/merkur windows set to 1990-1990 = effectively 'not sold 1990+' for phantom purposes; pre-1990 rows are out of scope for Pass 1.
